data.text: Yes, John—that arrangement works for me, provided the clinic confirms the need and all five of us agree. My family taught me that looking after our neighbors also means protecting the lake they depend on. I’ll plan on 10 tons for now. If the verified emergency requires 60 tons and there’s no other funding, I’ll commit to 12 tons today and 6 next month, with payment going directly to the clinic. Luke, would you join us on those equal terms and share the clinic contact so John can call?
